subject: Settlement linkage: activate banking + remittance mapping for Solvento Inc.

From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@solvento.com>

Cc: payments@solvento.com
Date: 2028-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: banking details + PO requirements for Redwood

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Attached are the files you requested: Solvento_W9.pdf and solvento_bank_info.csv (bank file contains account number masked and routing). We want to make sure our invoices will route correctly to Redwood’s AP system. Two items to confirm from your side:

- Remittance string: we prefer invoices to include the remit tag SOLV-INV so they auto-match in our AR.
- PO handling: we require PO# on the invoice header (PO prefix is SOLV-). If you have a PO field mapping template, please send it and we’ll align.

We will kick off an ACH micro-deposit test to verify the account. Our bank will send two small credits (USD) — expected window: Aug 12 by 15:00 PT. Once you confirm amounts, we’ll mark the account active.

Attached: Solvento_W9.pdf, solvento_bank_info.csv

Regards,
Carlos Mendes
Head of Finance Operations
Solvento Inc.

Carlos — thanks, got the W9 and CSV. I’ve logged this with Procurement and FinOps; looping Marissa for PO mapping and Prio (cc'd) for the ACH test. A couple quick clarifications before we run the test:

1) Legal entity on the W9 matches the bank file? If different, please confirm the DBA vs legal name and EIN.
2) For remittance matching we’ll publish the remit string you provided (SOLV-INV) to our supplier profile, but please confirm whether you need a specific invoice reference field (e.g., invoice_header vs invoice_memo). Our preferred field is invoice_header.PO.

Marissa — can FinOps run the micro-deposit verification against the masked account in the CSV? If you need the unmasked account to initiate the ACH, Carlos — can you confirm a secure portal or DocuSign channel to share full details?

I’ve added the PO-FieldMap-v2 template to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C4d5/edit

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu

Jasmine / Prio — I reviewed the CSV; masked account shows last4 4821, routing 122000247 (needs confirmation). Action items for FinOps: 

- Priyo: please request the full account number via the DocuSign link (DocuSign: docusign_0b1c2d3e) so we can submit an ACH pre-note. Do not paste full account numbers in thread.
- Run ACH micro-deposit verification on Aug 12 (bank ETA was this afternoon). When deposits land, note the two amounts and reply with exact cents so the vendor can confirm.
- Once confirmed, create supplier in NetSuite with remit string = SOLV-INV and PO prefix mapping: SOLV- (see attached PO-FieldMap-v2.xlsx). Add GL code default 5001 for professional services unless Solvento requests alternative.

Attached: PO-FieldMap-v2.xlsx

Please update this thread with the deposit amounts and the DocuSign status.

—Marissa
